entry_points.text: Merge-offset init and VMRUN entry validate, cache, retire and enter L2 or synthesize error with deferred work.
SMI follows GIF and SMM; nested query reports SVM format with probe support while restore validates before committing; PMU read validates indexes and MSR access installs masked values.
Legacy init derives kind from command; newer needs need-init plus explicit type; both converge on common init.

exports.text: SMI blocking query and special nested exit classifier are visible cross-file for host dispatch.
Mirror lock and one base ASID upper bound are shared; other base, extended and SNP bounds stay private.

hazards.text: PDPTE failure yields zero; bitmap failure aborts entry; ambiguous stage folds with warning; invalid cache fails entry; control-area memory failure becomes emulated fault or userspace exit without retry.
User images are length, format and consistency checked aborting cleanly; PMU accesses bound with safe indexing and masked selections; misuse warns with failures propagated.
ASID release marks reclaimable; transition failures bug VM, leak page and return IO error; empty-descriptor command fails as bad descriptor.

invariants.text: With Hyper-V state, refresh copies assist address and VM/VP ids; L2 flush needs nested control, direct hypercall, CPUID and generic tests; disabled build is no-ops.

Fault stage comes from hardware info for hardware exits else error code, ambiguous folds to final annotation; nested MMU pairs guest MMU with shadow paging MMU from L1 controls and cached CR3 plus helpers.
Bit math accepts three MSR windows with linear mapping; init builds dedup table of up to ten chunk indices from fixed groups, failing on bad conversion or overflow.

Bitmap bases need legal span; clear-valid injection passes else type and vectors checked with gated vectors; control needs VMRUN intercept, ASID, legal CR3 and ranges; save needs virt enable and coherent cache, debug, mode and regs; control copy clears gated bits and masks reserved, save copy carries regs, tables, pointers, CET and branch; soft is software or breakpoint/overflow, clear clean is dirty.

TSC composes L1 and L2 offsets and factors with default shortcut and refresh; throttle persists only on stable nonzero IP; secondary init resets flush, merges IRQ, copies vector and injection, adopts next IP, latches intent and gates pause and prediction.

Skip hides encrypted state else uses hardware next IP with fallback and shadow handling; MSR and port ownership follows intercepts plus bitmap decode; exceptions use per-vector bitmap; triple forwards only on shutdown intercept.
NMI and IRQ blocking share GIF and shadow gating with L1 bypass; vNMI applies only outside guest mode; GIF prefers virtual storage; SVM uses intercepts while VMX NMI uses pin controls.

Restore installs VMCB and images, selects secondary VMCB, reloads root and schedules work; deferred pages refresh PAE pointers then need merge and assist validation; GPA walk needs active context with elevation unless transparent.

Counter lookup bounds by count; MSR resolution splits control and count with capability checks; acceptance gates ranges by version; refresh picks version and clamps count; init prepares slots; disablement is mediation-aware.
Guest tests check locking then delegate with SNP needing extended; mirroring is nonzero owner; debug and secure TSC come from flags.
Master switches, hiding count, policy, save features and enc bit are post-init immutable; cgroup picks type; bind links id via activation; zero handle succeeds.
Pinning bounded by memory and memlock unless privileged; flush skipped when coherent; writeback hits only run CPUs; encryption uses adjusted addresses with contiguous grouping.

Diagnostics use module prefixes; soft check covers breakpoint and overflow; VNMI backing follows mode; post-init storage is immutable; run mask and request buffers use alloc-zero and free-clear; bug helper fires once per VM.

locks.text: Bitmap alloc has a dedicated mutex; mirroring has its own mutex; confidential checks need VM lock unless no users or in vCPU context.
Recycle holds guard for write while unbind holds for read; pin and unpin need VM lock with accounting; save sync needs vCPU mutex rejecting protected or debugging states.

state_machines.text: Merge honors Hyper-V fast path else idles unless L1 intercepts range; merging reads chunks, combines with host bitmap, clears recalc and publishes base, aborting on failure.

Sync refreshes injection merging only host-written IRQ bits with virtual controls gated; preparation forces reload on address change else refreshes dirty groups, picks PAT, loads state, flushes TLB, enters guest mode and requeues NMI.

VMRUN validates, maps and caches with faults distinct from validation errors, retires, preserves L1, sets pending run and unwinds on failure; entry records address, prepares state, loads root, enables GIF and schedules work.

Failures go to L1; exits consult bitmaps and intercepts with immediate nested exit on L1 decision; special routing sends IRQ, NMI, faults and hypercalls to host; pending events follow fixed priority with busy when blocked.
Mediated PMU needs version-two-plus host; entry drops stale overflow and installs guest status; exit stops counting and clears indications.

Recycle writebacks, flushes and merges unless busy; alloc scans with one recycle; creation picks interval and charges; guest init validates and acquires resources via legacy or explicit paths; launch pins, flushes and runs firmware per range.

structs.text: Cached control and save group ASID, intercepts, bases, offsets, IRQ, exit, injection, nested CR3, regs, tables, pointers, CET, PAT and branch; run and load-save groups split processor state; transfer starts cleared preserving cleanliness.

Nested dispatch covers leave, translation, classification, polling, triple, pages, save, restore and post-flush injection; PMU dispatch covers translation, validation, access, lifecycle and mediation; selector has counter and event values; region tracks range, pages and count.

Protocol versions one to two with paging-security and AP features; SNP error is all-ones 32-bit; AP holds none, event and register as zero to two; save area sits below canonical top; policy mask combines version, threading, debug, socket, interconnect, strength, power, hiding and swap.
Merge works in native word units; guest kinds are default, base, extended and SNP with extended defaulting to newer and SNP requiring newer.
